summary.text: Alan Silvia is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 7th Bristol District since January 2, 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as law enforcement officer, and he previously chaired the Fall River Planning Board.

paragraphs.text: Alan Silvia attended B.M.C. Durfee High School and, according to Ballotpedia, holds a bachelor's degree from Northeastern University and a graduate degree from Salve Regina University.
Ballotpedia lists military service in the U.S. Marine Corps and a profession in law enforcement, and notes that he was previously chairman of the City of Fall River Planning Board.

He assumed office in the 7th Bristol District on January 2, 2013; for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the House Ways and Means Committee and the Public Safety and Homeland Security, Public Service, Veterans and Federal Affairs, and Ways and Means joint committees.
